title: BelugaXL and A380
imageAlt: Two-page sketchbook spread of an Airbus BelugaXL cargo plane and the tail of an A380, with a small standing figure for scale
purpose: Study the scale relationships between very large aircraft, ground equipment and people.
approach: The two aircraft are read as large simple volumes. A small standing figure and the boarding stairs fix the scale; surface detail is limited to panel lines, livery and a few shadow planes.

title: Architecture in blue ballpoint
imageAlt: Blue ballpoint pen sketch of a stepped building with tall columns and statues on top, with a detail of one statue
purpose: Study how a monumental façade is built from repeated verticals and stacked terraces.
approach: A single blue line carries the structure: strong verticals for the columns, stacked horizontals for the terraces, hatching for shade. Ochre marker marks the main horizontal bands, and a small side study isolates one statue.

title: Night by the river
imageAlt: Violet and blue marker sketch of a crowd at night in front of a cable-stayed bridge and a TV tower
purpose: Capture the depth of an urban night scene: a bridge and a tower seen over a dense crowd.
approach: The crowd in the foreground is reduced to simple dark and light shapes. The bridge cables set the perspective lines, and layers of violet marker separate the sky from the structures.

title: HMS Sutherland
imageAlt: Marker and pencil sketch of the frigate HMS Sutherland moored at a quay, with flags along the deck
purpose: Study the proportions, structure and visual hierarchy of a modern naval vessel.
approach: The ship is read as a few large volumes: hull, superstructure and mast. Cross-hatching shapes the curve of the hull, while rigging, flags and equipment are added as progressively smaller detail.

title: Classic car
imageAlt: Colored pencil drawing of a turquoise 1950s American car in three-quarter view, with chrome grille and tailfins
purpose: Study the curved surfaces, reflections and chrome detail of a classic car.
approach: Body volumes are modelled with layered color, while a few strong highlights and dark accents describe the glass and chrome. The background stays as loose pencil strokes so the car remains the focus.

title: Crossbow ranger
imageAlt: Full-length drawing of a ranger in a green plaid shirt holding a crossbow, with tools hanging from the belt
purpose: Show a character's role and habits through costume, equipment and stance.
approach: A calm upright pose keeps the silhouette readable. The tool belt, layered clothing and crossbow carry the narrative detail, with color concentrated on the shirt and boots.
